params.body:
## Why

On the photo tab of the vehicle sheet, the pair of thumbnails that picks the background a photo gets after the cut-out (`ui-bg-choice`) was 56x36 px. At that size the dark and the light background are two colour smudges: the dealer picks from memory instead of from what is on screen. Shane asked for samples you can actually tell apart.

## What

`resources/css/refresh.css` only, no markup and no JavaScript.

- `.ui-edit .ui-bg-sample` goes from 56x36 to 84x56, radius 8 to 10. That is 3:2, the usual ratio of a car photo. There is no imposed background size: `SettingsController::saveBackgroundFile()` scales an upload to fit 1920 while keeping its own ratio, so the sample keeps `object-fit: cover`, which crops and never distorts whatever the dealer uploaded.
- The check badge grows with it: 20x20 to 28x28, font 10 to 13, so it stays a badge on the sample rather than a dot.
- Breathing space: `.ui-bg-choice` gap 8 to 10 and padding-right 12 to 16; `.ui-bulk-actions` gap 12 to `10px 14px` so a wrapped row does not stick to the row above it.
- Under 768px the choice takes its own full-width line and drops its right-hand divider. That divider used to hang at the right edge with nothing after it once the row wrapped.

On desktop the label, the divider and the neighbouring actions (remove background, duplicate, selection counter, delete) still sit on one line at 1280.

Checked for the same pattern elsewhere: the settings Background pane already shows the two backgrounds as full-width `h-40` cards (PR 255), and the showroom poster pane has no background sample at all. Nothing else to make consistent, and the settings pane is untouched.

## Screenshots

Photo tab toolbar, before and after, at 1280 and at 390: `bgsample-{before,after}-{1280,390}.png`.

At 1280 the two samples go from postage stamps next to the label to two readable pictures; at 390 the choice moves to its own line with the stray divider gone.

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` and `php -l` over all 455 compiled views: clean.
- `npm run build`: green (`public/build` is not committed).
- `phpunit --filter 'SmokeTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|Vehicle|Photo'`: 241 tests, 7 failures, all seven identical on a stashed baseline of the same checkout (`OwnVehicleAuthorizationTest` x6 and `VehicleSheetEmptyAmountTest` x1) and unrelated to a stylesheet change. `StylesheetSyntaxTest` (braces and every `ui-` class used) and `UiApiUsageTest` pass.
- Behaviour untouched: `vehicle.updateBackground()` in `resources/js/vehicle/vehicle.js` selects on `.background-switch-wrapper` and its `i` child, and toggles `actief`; the Alpine state (`sel`, `selBg`), the `x-show`, the ids and the `onclick` handlers in `resources/views/ownstock/_tabs/photos.blade.php` are all unchanged. Grepped for `ui-bg-choice`, `ui-bg-sample`, `selBg` and `background-switch-wrapper` across `resources/` before touching anything.
params.title: Photo tab: larger background samples
